build_DiffJPEG: build a DiffJPEG module that applies JPEG compression artifacts to a tensor with configurable quality
create_RandomDiffJPEG: create a RandomDiffJPEG augmentation that randomly selects JPEG quality factors from a range for batched tensors
create_RandomBlur: create a RandomBlur augmentation that randomly selects Gaussian blur kernel sizes for batched image tensors
build_HiddenAug: build a HiddenAug module that applies a random sequence of crops, blur, JPEG, rotation, and color jitter augmentations
build_KorniaAug: build a KorniaAug module that chains JPEG, affine, crop, blur, color jitter, and horizontal flip augmentations
